verses.text: And it happened, at the time of the return of the year, at the time of the going out of the kings, that Joab led out the force of the host and destroyed the land of the sons of Ammon, and he came in and besieged Rabbah. And David stayed at Jerusalem. And Joab defeated Rabbah and overthrew it.

verses.text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and he found it to weigh a talent of gold, and in it [were] precious stones, and it was on the head of David. And the plunder of the city he brought out in great abundance.

verses.text: And the people who [were] in it he brought out, and they sawed with the saws, and with the iron picks, and with the axes. Thus David did to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. And David returned, and all the people, [to] Jerusalem.

verses.text: And it came to pass afterward that war broke out in Gezer with the Philistines. At that time Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai of the sons of the Rephaim, and they were subdued.

verses.text: And there was again war with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the shaft of his spear [was] like a beam of a weaver.
